theorems.statement: (∀ (N N' k : ℕ) (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N') (β : Covector (Euclid N') k), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.compContinuousLinearMap A) ≤ ‖A‖ ^ k * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → (∀ (N k : ℕ) (v : Euclid N) (β : Covector (Euclid N) (k + 1)), covectorEuclideanNorm (β.curryLeft v) ≤ ‖v‖ * covectorEuclideanNorm β) → ∀ (N N' m : ℕ) (σ : DifferentialForm (Euclid (N + 1)) (m + 1)) (x : Euclid N) (α : Covector (Euclid N) m) (Λ δ c : ℝ), Continuous σ → (∀ v : Fin m → Euclid N, α v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, σ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i)))))) → (∀ t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∃ (γ : Covector (Euclid N') (m + 1)) (u : Euclid N') (A : Euclid N →L[ℝ] Euclid N'), ‖A‖ ≤ Λ ∧ ‖u‖ ≤ δ ∧ covectorEuclideanNorm γ ≤ c ∧ ∀ v : Fin m → Euclid N, σ (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (Fin.cons (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp (v i))))) = γ (Fin.cons u (fun i => A (v i)))) → covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ Λ ^ m * δ * c
